reply.text:
Knee sleeves are a personal call, and mostly about comfort and warmth rather than a fix for anything. Plenty of lifters wear them for the warmth and the feedback on their knees, and plenty train without and do fine. If you wear them, pick a pair that compresses without bunching or sliding down during the set, and keep the setup the same every session so your squats stay comparable.

If your knees are sore or something feels off when you squat, that is one for a doctor or physio rather than a coach, and I'll train around whatever they clear. Otherwise, what are you squatting at the moment?
